content:
Hey everyone!

This is the list of all the changes we've done to our projects during the month of September.

  • Wiki, added portland island, and updated alcohol stove.
  • Donsol, released on Itch.io!
  • Legs, we made a last minute gizmo for Catjam 2026.
  • Rabbit Waves, finished a page about One-time Pads.
  • Rejoice, discovered infinity.
  • Tote, added support for I/O.
  • Korokobot, added a page on Processing Analog Art.

We're disheartened to see a lot of the organization for direct action done on platforms that spy on its users, we've often talked about how it would be worthwhile to offer basic cryptography know-how to our friends, and so for a second month now, we're releasing a new Rabbit Waves page on how to encrypt and decrypt messages, this time using One-Time Pads.

Ten years after the original release of Donsol, we decided to make a new version with animated sprites and a proper in-game manual as a definitive release, and it's finally out and available directly in the browser or your favourite Uxn emulator!

Devine has been invited to Oredev 2026 in Sweden to talk about software archival, because of it this month was spent making a lot of slides and talk notes. As usual, we'll share the full transcription after the conference.

Book Club: We read To Kill a Mockingbird by Harper Lee, Madame Bovary by Gustave Flaubert, and we are still re-reading Dracula by Bram Stoker.
